description: Source code for managing WiFi services, including creation, deletion, start, stop, and event handling of WiFi service instances within a management framework.

methods.name: get_service_name_from_type
methods.description: Maps a service type to its corresponding service name string.

methods.name: get_service_by_type
methods.description: Retrieves a WiFi service instance by its type from the manager.

methods.name: services_mgr_delete_service
methods.description: Deletes a service by name from the manager.

methods.name: services_mgr_delete_service_by_type
methods.description: Deletes a service by its type.

methods.name: create_service
methods.description: Creates a new WiFi service instance based on the service name and configuration.

methods.name: services_mgr_event
methods.description: Dispatches an event to all managed services.

methods.name: services_mgr_init
methods.description: Initializes the services manager with provided configurations and services.
